usageNotes: Retrieves the raw CRUSH map text from the specified Ceph-enabled PVE node; use this to inspect placement rules, device classes, and bucket hierarchies for an existing Ceph cluster. The target node must be online and have Ceph configured — calling it on a node without Ceph will return an error. Requires either Sys.Audit or Datastore.Audit at the root path.

examples.summary: Fetch the CRUSH map from the primary Ceph monitor node

tips: The response is a raw compiled CRUSH map in text form; pipe it through 'crushtool -d' locally if you need to decompile and diff against a modified version.
If you intend to modify placement rules, capture this output first as a baseline before calling any CRUSH-editing endpoints.
Any healthy cluster node that hosts a Ceph monitor can serve this endpoint — use a monitor node for the most authoritative view.
